value: The memory of the righteous is with praise, but for you, O Forerunner, the testimony of the Lord suffices. For you were shown to be truly the most honorable of the prophets, since you were deemed worthy to baptize the One preached in the streams. Therefore, having suffered for the truth with joy, you proclaimed good tidings even to those in Hades: God who appeared in the flesh, taking away the sin of the world, and granting us great mercy.
